pages.title: Holographic Matrix
pages.text: A three-dimensional object stored entirely on its two-dimensional boundary, just as the holographic principle says all the information in a volume is encoded on its surface. The matrix is a cube whose faces hold everything inside it. Looking through it, the interior shifts when I tilt the surface.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Holographic Encoder, I recorded the interior of a Metamaterial Sheet onto its surface using a Quantum Processor and a condensate. Then I deleted the interior. Nothing changed. The surface held everything.
